arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Treasury notes data (in millions of dollars)
nyc_treasury_notes = 1325  # 16 New York City banks
chicago_treasury_notes = 475  # 14 Chicago banks

# Total market for Treasury notes (just these two groups)
total_market = nyc_treasury_notes + chicago_treasury_notes
print(f"Total Treasury notes market (2 groups): {total_market} million")

# Market shares
nyc_share = nyc_treasury_notes / total_market
chicago_share = chicago_treasury_notes / total_market
print(f"NYC share: {nyc_share}")
print(f"Chicago share: {chicago_share}")

# Herfindahl Hirschman Index (HHI) = sum of squared market shares
hhi = nyc_share**2 + chicago_share**2
print(f"HHI: {hhi}")

# Effective number of bank groups = 1/HHI
effective_number = 1 / hhi
print(f"Effective number: {effective_number}")

# Round to thousandths
hhi_rounded = round(hhi, 3)
effective_rounded = round(effective_number, 3)
print(f"\nRounded to thousandths:")
print(f"HHI: {hhi_rounded}")
print(f"Effective number: {effective_rounded}")

# Output format
print(f"\nAnswer: [{hhi_rounded}, {effective_rounded}]")
EOF
